# Retry failed schedule deliveries twice

## Context

Delivery to a class can fail while the release job runs.

## Decision

Retry a failed delivery twice before reporting it.

## Consequences

A delivery can arrive up to two retry intervals late.

BEH-ASMT-SCHEDULE.md.body:
# Schedule a student assessment

## Behavior

A teacher submits a release time for a published assessment and a class.

## Preconditions

The teacher may assign to the class.

## Outcomes

Success: the assessment is scheduled. Failure: nothing is scheduled.

notes: The body states the promise, so editing it moves the content hash.

name: P04 content-v1 pins need review when an explained behavior's links change
notes: Dropping a governing rule changes what the behavior promises. RULE-ASMT-AUTH's pin is no longer required, and the behavior's own pin no longer matches. The rule, now unattached, is the CORE009 warning.

name: P04 content-v1 pins need review when an explained behavior's availability changes
notes: Availability is part of the promise. The registries add the edition so the change is valid; the request still applies, so the only problem is the review.

# Require permission to assign to the class

The server must reject scheduling unless the assessment is published and the actor is authorized to assign it to the requested class.

notes: A review record without hash pins each source's whole file, as every review before 0.13.0 does, and is read as it always was: any edit to the source, its status included, needs review.

notes: Literal whole-file pins of the baseline's sources, with nothing changed: the earlier pin kind still reads as current.
